0.description: The endless font of aether rising from Pagos far below continues into the skies high above...
0.translation_description: La fonte inesauribile di etere che sale dal lontano Pagos prosegue verso il cielo, sempre più in alto...

1.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3AETHERFLOW_00524_SYSTEM_000_661
1.description: In mere moments, the treated magicite grows bright and warm, as it reacts to the torrential stream of aether, as Krile hoped it would...
1.translation_description: In pochi istanti, la magicite trattata si fa luminosa e calda, reagendo al flusso impetuoso di etere proprio come sperava Krile...
